work.originalTitle: ピョ・ウンジ1st写真集 輪舞曲
work.summary: Rondo, the Japanese KADOKAWA photobook of Korean model/YouTuber 표은지 (Pyo Eunji), has separate print and electronic editions released 2023-08-10. The distinct all-other-photo companion 円舞曲 is catalogued as its own title.

edition.contentSummary: Official KADOKAWA electronic Rondo edition, publisher release 2023-08-10. Apple Books Japan publicly reports 136 digital pages, file size 74.7 MB, publisher KADOKAWA, seller DWANGO Co., Ltd., and displayed JPY 3,400 on 2026-10-23. Page/file figures are Apple-specific; ebook file format is unverified. Print A4/128-page specifications, ISBN 9784048976268 and JPY 3,300 paper price are not copied into the ebook. Public preview pricing does not establish account/storefront purchase eligibility. Publisher cover remains the source-attributed remote cover; no pixels mirrored or reuse license asserted.

work.englishTitle: Pyo Eunji Digital Photobook: Enbukyoku (All-Other Edition)
work.summary: Separate KADOKAWA digital companion photobook featuring Korean model 표은지 (Pyo Eunji), titled 円舞曲 and labeled All-Other Edition. The publisher describes it as a second chapter following Rondo; its release and content identity are recorded independently.

edition.contentSummary: Separate KADOKAWA All-Other Edition digital companion titled 円舞曲, publisher release 2023-11-30. Apple Books Japan publicly reports 104 digital pages, file size 116 MB, publisher KADOKAWA, seller DWANGO Co., Ltd., and displayed JPY 2,200 on 2026-10-23. Page/file figures are Apple-specific; ebook file format and ISBN are unverified. This companion is not merged with standard Rondo or its print edition. Public preview pricing does not establish account/storefront purchase eligibility. Publisher cover remains source-attributed and remote; no pixels mirrored or reuse license asserted.
